verses.text: Ayik kajanxoek' winhaj rey David t'a yol spalacio ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Natán schekab' Dios icha tik: --Ilnab'i, a in tik ayinxo och t'a yol in palacio nab'a k'ute' ayoch t'ay, palta haxo skaxail strato Jehová, ha t'a yol mantiado ayek'i, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Natán chi' icha tik: --Syalnhej a b'oan masanil tas tza nib'ej yujto ayoch Dios het'ok, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix lolon Dios t'a winhaj Natán chi', ix yalan t'a winh icha tik:
Ixik, b'at al t'a winh in chekab' aj David to a in Jehová in swal icha tik t'a winh: Manhok ach ol a b'ok'e junok in templo b'aj ol in kajnajok.
Yiktax wik'annakelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto masanto tiknaik, manta b'aj tzin kajnaj t'a yol junok pat, palta to anhej t'a yoltak mantiado ix in ajek'i.

Masanil tiempo ix in b'eyek' yet' heb' he mam eyicham chi', malaj b'aj walnak t'a heb' yajalil heb' skuchb'ani to sb'o junok templo heb' nab'a k'ute' tz'och t'ay b'aj tzin kajnaji, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh.
Tzalanpax t'a winh to a in swal icha tik: Ha in Jehová Yajal waj t'a smasanil, a in swal icha tik: Ha in ix ach wik'el t'a tanhwum kalnelal yik tzach och yajalil t'a in chonhab' Israel tik.
B'ajtaktil ix ach ek'i ayinnhej och het'ok, ix in satel masanil heb' ajk'ol ix ak'an owal het'ok, ol ach wak'an b'inajok, icha sb'inaj heb' niwak yajal ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Hanhejtona' ix in sik'elta jun lum b'aj tzex kajnajkan a ex in chonhab' ex tik. Ha tik ol ex kannhej kajan t'a junelnhej. Manhxa mach ol ex xib'tanok, manhxo ol ex tzuntzaj yuj heb' eyajk'o'ol icha ix ex yutej heb' t'a sb'ab'elal,
ayik ix wak'anoch heb' ix ex kuchb'ani. Ha in ol in satel masanil heb' eyajk'o'ol. Swak'anpax ojtakejeli to ol wak'nhej opisio t'a heb' inhtilal.
Ayik ol lajwokek' a k 'inal, yik mukb'il hachxo, ol wak'och junok uninal reyal a k'exulok, tek'an wal ol wutej yopisio chi'.
Ha jun uninal chi' ol b'oank'e in templo b'aj ol in b'inajok. Ha in ol wak'nhejkan yopisio chi' t'a yinhtilal.

Ha in ol in och smamok, haxo ol och wuninalok. Malaj b'ak'inh ol waktejkan in xajanani. Manh ichaok wutejnak waktankan in xajanan winhaj Saúl, wik'nakel winh t'a yopisio yik ach och sk'exulok winh, manh ichok ta' ol wutok.
Ol wak'nhej yopisio uninal chi' t'a in chonhab'. Ha yopisio chi' ol b'eynhejb'at t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Natán chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Natán chi', ix yal winh t'a winhaj rey David chi'.

Yuj chi' ix och winh rey chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, ix em k'ojan winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová in Diosal, ¿tas wal welk'och a in tik? ¿tas pax wal yelk'och heb' in mam wicham, yuj chi' niwan a wach'k'olal tzak' t'ayin?

Ach in Diosal, manhoknhej juntzanh tik ix ak' t'ayin, wan alanpaxkani to ol ak' a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' winhtilal t'a b'ak'inh. Lajan tzin utej icha juntzanh heb' niwak winak t'a sat lu'um tik.
¿Tasto wal syal walan t'ayach yuj sniwanil welk'och tzak'a'? Ha ach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak wal tas waji.
Mamin Jehová, yujto tzin a xajanej a in a chekab' in tik, yuj chi' ix el t'a a k'o'ol, ix ak'an juntzanh opisio satub'tak tik t'ayin, ix ak'an wojtakejeli.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo mach lajan het'ok. Ha achnhej toni, malaj junokxo Dios skab' spekal icha ach tik.

Ha onh pax a chonhab' Israel onh tik, malaj junokxo chonhab' lajan ket'ok, yujto a ach ix onh a kolo', yik tzonh ochkan a chonhab'ok. Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, te niwan ix aj a b'inaj ku'uj, yujto a k'ulejnak tas satub'tak ayik a kolannakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto. Ik'annakel juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yichanh heb'.
Yujto ix onh ak'och a chonhab'ok t'a junelnhej. Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, ach ochkan ko Diosalok.
Ha tiknaik Mamin Jehová, elokab'k'och tas ix alkan t'ayin a in a chekab' in tik yet' t'a heb' winhtilal.

Elokab'k'och tas ix ala', yik wach' tzach ik'jicha'anh. Mamin Jehová, ol alchajok to a ach Yajal aj t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal ach pax a onh israel onh tik. Ol ochnhej pax winhtilal t'a reyal t'a junelnhej t'a ichanh.
Mamin ach in Diosal, ix ak' wojtakejeli to ol ochnhejkan winhtilal t'a wopisio. Yuj chi' tzin tek'b'ej in b'a in lesalwi t'ayach.
Ha ach tik Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach, a ach ix alkan jun wach'ilal tik t'ayin.

Ha tiknaik jun, elokab' t'a a k'ol ak'an a wach'k'olal t'a winhtilal, yik wach' ol ajnhej ek' heb' t'a ichanh. Ha ach ol ak' a wach'k'olal t'a heb', ol scha'annhej heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winhaj rey David chi' t'a Jehová.
